title: Indie Author seeking experienced character artists for dark fantasy book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT. Actively reviewing submissions and building longlist (see updates).
